hero.headline: Resilience isn't a soft skill. It's your leadership team's operating system.
hero.sub: Built on the science of stress, recovery and sustained performance.
hero.body: Resilience Code Plus+ helps fast-growing companies turn resilience into a daily practice, so leaders perform in week eight of pressure the way they performed in week one.
hero.body2: Not a one-off workshop. A system your leaders live in every day.

pov.headline: Resilience is not a soft metric. It's the variable that decides whether your leaders hold under pressure.
pov.body1: Every growth-stage company asks its leaders to carry more: faster change, higher stakes, longer weeks. Most training addresses this once a year. Pressure shows up every day.
pov.body2: As your company scales, every leader's ability to stay steady under load compounds, or erodes, everything downstream: decisions, teams, retention, execution.
pov.body3: The companies that pull ahead won't be the ones with the most talented leaders. They'll be the ones whose leaders can stay resourced, clear and consistent, week after week.
pov.statsNote: Harvard-validated impact · Prof. Shawn Achor / KPMG study, 2009

audit.headline: How durable is your leadership team, really?
audit.body1: Resilience isn't visible until it's tested, and by then it's expensive to fix. The Resilience Audit is a structured look across five dimensions of leadership resilience: recovery, focus under pressure, emotional regulation, purpose, and physical readiness.
audit.body2: We'll walk your team through where they're coded for pressure, and where they're exposed, then show you how Resilience Code Plus+ closes the gap with daily practice, not another one-off workshop.

items.content: Eve caught what I couldn't see myself, that I was running on empty three weeks before I would have admitted it. That's the whole point.
The Think Tank sessions were the most honest conversations I've had with peers about pressure. We're all carrying more than we let on.
Two minutes a day sounded too small to matter. Eight weeks in, it's the only habit that's stuck through every busy season.
